summary: Implemented the PLAN2D Postgres-side meal-plan shopping orchestration layer with a deterministic orchestration-run table, mirrored coordinator modules, a CLI, focused tests, docs, and handoff artifacts. The slice reuses existing PLAN1, PLAN2A, PLAN2A.1, PLAN2B, and PLAN2C modules instead of introducing a second shopping or optimizer stack.

Focused PLAN2D tests passed for existing-plan chaining, generated-plan chaining, partial-gap handling, deterministic run-key reuse, CLI parsing, and no-Firestore/no-LLM/no-new-optimizer boundaries.
Full repository test suite passed with PLAN2D included in the repo-level runner.
Documentation validation passed after PLAN2D repo-map, schema-map, data-model, orchestration doc, registry, changelog, artifact, and handoff updates.
